text: Once upon a time, there lived a curious girl named Alice.
One sunny afternoon, she was by a river, daydreaming.
Suddenly, she saw a white rabbit wearing a vest rush by, muttering, "Oh dear! I shall be late!"
She chose to follow the rabbit and tumbled down a rabbit hole into a mysterious world.
She landed softly in a hallway full of doors.
She looked around and saw that the only door that opened was much too small for her to fit through.
On a table, she found a bottle labeled "Drink Me to Shrink".

text: Reading instructions and thinking ahead help you stay safe!
The bottle says that it's for "Guests of Wonderland", and gives instructions on how to use it.
Alice sipped the potion and shrank to fit through a small door, leading to a beautiful garden.
Along the way, she met a caterpillar who gave her confusing advice about how to change her size by eating a mushroom.
The caterpillar sang, "Up and down and all around, the mushrooms will keep ya safe and sound! Big or small or not at all!"
The caterpillar's advice doesn't make much sense.

text: Just like with the potion, putting something into your body without proper instructions can be a bad idea.

text: When advice is unclear, asking questions and starting small is smart!
Alice asks the caterpillar how many mushrooms she should eat if she wants to return to her old size,
and the caterpillar replies that a small bite should do it! She's thankful she asked a follow-up question.
She eats a small bite of the mushroom, then keeps walking until she meets a cat, who smiles and shows her two paths:
one to a tea party,
and one to the Queen's castle.
The cat tells her the caterpillar and rabbit will also be at the tea party,
but the Queen has a very beautiful castle.
